caption:
CALEB WILLIAMS IS MAKING A STATEMENT 🔥

Williams went off in Week 1:

334 total yards | 4 total TD | 0 INT

Williams threw for 269 yards and 2 touchdowns while adding 65 rushing yards and 2 more scores on the ground as Chicago dominated Carolina 59-37.

Is Caleb Williams ready to take the next step and become an elite NFL quarterback?

#nfl #bears #calebwilliams #football

KING HENRY IS STILL ELITE 👑

Henry dominated in Week 1:

144 rushing yards | 3 rushing TD

Henry found the end zone three times on the ground as Baltimore defeated Indianapolis 41-23 to open the season.

Is Derrick Henry still one of the best running backs in football?

#nfl #ravens #derrickhenry #football

JALEN COKER WENT OFF 🔥

Coker had a huge Week 1 performance:

8 REC | 138 YDS | 2 TD

Coker caught 8 passes for 138 yards and 2 touchdowns in Carolina's 59-37 loss to Chicago, emerging as one of the Panthers' biggest offensive bright spots.

Could Jalen Coker establish himself as one of the NFL's top young receivers?

#nfl #panthers #jalencoker #football
